H3700.def: a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear:--(have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.def: from «03700»; silver (from its pale color); by implication, money:--money, price, silver(-ling).

H3703.def: perhaps from «03701»; silvery; Casiphja, a place in Bab.:--Casiphia.

H3704.def: from «03680»; a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed):--pillow.

H3706.def: (Aramaic) or kaeth (Aramaic) {keh-eth'}; feminine of «03705»; thus (only in the formula "and so forth"):--at such a time.

H3707.def: a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant:--be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.def: or (in Job) kaoas {kah'-as}; from «03707»; vexation: -anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, × sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.def: from «03721»; the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power:--branch, + foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H3711.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue:--pacify.

H3712.def: feminine of «03709»; a leaf of a palm-tree:--branch.

H3713.def: from «03722»; properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground):--bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3714.et: from an unused root meaning to connect
H3714.def: from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder:--beam.

H3715.def: from «03722»; a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane):--(young) lion, village. Compare «03723».

H3716.def: feminine of «03715»; the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine:--Chephirah.

H3717.def: a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat:--double.

H3720.def: from «03719»; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain):--famine.

H3721.def: a primitive root; to curve:--bow down (self).

H3722.def: a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel:-- appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).

H3723.def: from «03722»; a village (as protected by walls): -village. Compare «03715».

H3724.def: from «03722»; properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price:--bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3726.et: from (03723) and (05984), with the article interposed
H3726.def: from «03723» and «05984», with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine:--Chefar-haamonai.

H3727.def: from «03722»; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark):--mercy seat.

H3728.def: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate:--cover.

H3729.def: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter:--bind.

H3730.et: probably from an unused root meaning to encircle
H3730.def: or (Am. 9:1) kaphtowr {kaf-tore'}; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of a column, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum: knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.def: or (Am. 9:7) Kaphtowr {kaf-tore'}; apparently the same as «03730»; Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines:--Caphtor.

H3732.def: patrial from «03731»; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor:--Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

H3733.et: from (03769) in the sense of plumpness
H3733.def: from «03769» in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out):--captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also «01033», «03746».

H3734.def: from the same as «03564»; properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry:--cor, measure. Aramaic the same.

H3735.et: probably corresponding to (03738) in sense of piercing (fig.)
H3735.def: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to «03738» in the sense of piercing (figuratively); to grieve:--be grieved.

H3736.def: from the same as «03525»; to gird or clothe: -clothed.

H3737.et: from a verb corresponding to that of (03736)
H3737.def: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of «03736»; a mantle:--hat.

H3738.def: a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open:--dig, × make (a banquet), open.

H3739.et: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of (03738) (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain)
H3739.def: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of «03738» (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase:--buy, prepare.

H3742.def: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure:--cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3743.def: the same as «03742»; Kerub, a place in Bab.: -Cherub.

H3745.def: (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim:--make a proclamation.

H3746.et: perhaps an abridged plural of (03733) in the sense of leader (of the flock)
H3746.def: perhaps an abridged plural of «03733» in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman:--captains, Cherethites (from the margin).

H3747.def: from «03772»; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine: -Cherith.

H3748.def: from «03772»; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce:--divorce(-ment).

H3749.def: expanded from the same as «03522»; a rim or top margin:--compass.

H3750.def: probably of foreign origin; the crocus:--saffron.

H3751.def: of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria:--Carchemish.

H3752.def: of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes: -Carcas.

H3753.def: from «03769»; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing):--swift beast.

H3754.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3754.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard:--vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also «01021».

H3755.et: act. participle of an imaginary denominative from (03754)
H3755.def: active participle of an imaginary denominative from «03754»; a vinedresser:--vine dresser (as one or two words).

H3756.def: from «03754»; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites:--Carmi.

H3757.def: patronymically from «03756»; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi:--Carmites.

H3758.def: probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red: -crimson.

H3759.def: from «03754»; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce:--full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

H3760.def: the same as «03759»; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine:--Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3761.def: patron from «03760»; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town):--Carmelite.

H3762.def: feminine of «03761»; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel:--Carmelitess.

H3763.def: of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean:--Cheran.

H3766.def: a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate:--bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, × very.

H3767.def: from «03766»; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual):--leg.

H3768.def: of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool: -green.

H3769.def: a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl): -dance(-ing).

H3770.def: by variation from «07164»; the paunch or belly (as swelling out):--belly.

H3771.def: of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes:--Carshena.

H3772.def: a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces):--be chewed, be con-(feder-)ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league ((covenant)), × lose, perish, × utterly, × want.

H3773.def: passive participle feminine of «03772»; something cut, i.e. a hewn timber:--beam.

H3774.et: probably from (03772) in the sense of executioner
H3774.def: probably from «03772» in the sense of executioner; a Kerethite or life-guardsman (compare «02876») (only collectively in the singular as plural):--Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3775.def: apparently by transposition for «03532»; a young sheep:--lamb.

H3777.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3777.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham:--Onesed.

H3778.def: (occasionally with enclitic) Kasdiymah {kas-dee'- maw}; towards the Kasdites:--into Chaldea), patronymically from 3777 (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people:--Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.

H3779.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03778»; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer:--Chaldean.

H3780.def: a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh):--be covered. Compare «03680».

H3781.def: from «03782»; properly, a feller, i.e. an axe: -ax.

H3782.def: a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall:--bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, × utterly, be weak.

H3783.def: from «03782»; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin:--fall.

H3784.def: a primitive root; properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic:--sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).

H3787.def: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper:-- direct, be right, prosper.

H3789.def: a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe):--describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).

H3791.def: from «03789»; something written, i.e. a writing, record or book:--register, scripture, writing.

H3793.def: from «03789»; a letter or other mark branded on the skin:--X any (mark).

H3794.et: patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the pl.)
H3794.def: or Kittiyiy {kit-tee-ee'}; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine:--Chittim, Kittim.

H3796.et: from an unused root meaning to compact
H3796.def: from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates):--wall.

H3798.def: from «03796» and «0376»; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine:--Kithlish.

H3799.def: a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly:--mark.
